title: MaleTheme Duo #023 · 남 머슬 모델·코퍼 브론즈·악마 테마 / 남 V자 보디빌더·펄 화이트 글로시·서퍼 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright bamboo grove with a smooth stone path, tall green bamboo on both sides, a waist-high bamboo fence and a standard gate, bright and backlit, shadows falling toward the camera, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, backlit by the low sun, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Nigerian man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, copper-bronze smoky eyes with a golden highlight, deep rich dark-brown skin with a smooth satin glow, a gentle soft smile, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long rose-gold chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (an iron small flared temple bell, a tin chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver ship's anchor, an iron round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked rose-gold anklets. Extremely long almond nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a pair of small curved black horns on his head, a thin pointed devil tail, a black leather collar, and a minimal glossy black leather T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme silver platform stiletto studded boots, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Japanese man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, smooth pale skin with a cool undertone, a cool composed look, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in braided, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large platinum hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a silver barrel-shaped weight, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered gold anklets. RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a shark-tooth necklace and a minimal neon-orange T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, soaked and clinging, water streaming down his whole body in glistening rivulets with countless droplets clinging to his skin, his hair soaking wet and slicked.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform stiletto knee-high boots, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: a bright rim of sunlight outlining every figure, each material catching the backlight in glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
